name: homelab-runbooks
description: Serves any MkDocs Material docs site (runbooks, wikis, project docs - anything written in Markdown with an mkdocs.yml) as a live-rendered site. Point it at a read-only clone of your own docs git repo; edit the source on GitHub or locally, not in the container, and pull to refresh.

paths.name: Docs repo (read-only)
paths.description: Read-only bind mount to a cloned docs git repo containing mkdocs.yml at its root.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port serving the rendered docs.
